title.narrative: LAC education systems governance, policy, management, and curriculum frameworks strengthened to ensure inclusive and quality education for all

description.narrative: UNESCO Santiago will support Member States in strengthening education systems governance, planning, management, curriculum, monitoring and evaluation to advance inclusive and quality lifelong learning opportunities in Latin America and the Caribbean. The work will focus on evidence-informed policymaking, strengthening EMIS and the use of disaggregated data, while promoting integrated approaches linking planning, financing, curriculum, assessment and learning outcomes. Key initiatives include SIRIED, the Community of Specialists in Data for Educational Planning, and the Regional Observatory on Artificial Intelligence in Education. Through LLECE, UNESCO Santiago will disseminate ERCE 2025 results, launch the ERCE 2030 cycle, and strengthen countries’ capacities to use learning and contextual data to improve quality, equity and educational transformation.
